description: New York Department of State active corporations: searches by entity name and returns entity type, county, initial filing date and service-of-process address. Public open data (Socrata), updated monthly; not a credit or ownership report. Takes about 20 s; allow a 45 s timeout. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Entity name part, letters, digits, spaces, . , & and - only, 2 to 80 characters
